description: Weekly inventory variance per menu item — coloured by T01 tolerance bands from Phase 2 G13

panels.title: Items Outside T01 Tolerance (this week)
panels.description: Count of menu items where actual usage vs expected > ±T01 band

targets.rawSql: WITH weekly_variance AS ( SELECT mi.name AS item, SUM(ABS(sm.delta)) AS actual_usage, SUM(ri.quantity_per_unit * o_count.cnt) AS expected_usage FROM stock_movements sm JOIN inventory_lots il ON sm.inventory_lot_id = il.id JOIN inventory_items ii ON il.inventory_item_id = ii.id JOIN recipe_ingredients ri ON ri.inventory_item_id = ii.id JOIN menu_items mi ON ri.menu_item_id = mi.id CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE placed_at >= DATE_TRUNC('week', NOW()) AND state NOT IN ('cancelled') ) o_count WHERE sm.at >= DATE_TRUNC('week', NOW()) AND sm.delta < 0 GROUP BY mi.name ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM weekly_variance WHERE actual_usage > expected_usage * 1.10 OR actual_usage < expected_usage * 0.90

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(wl.quantity * ii.cost_per_unit_zar), 0)::float / 100 AS value FROM waste_log wl JOIN inventory_lots il ON wl.inventory_lot_id = il.id JOIN inventory_items ii ON il.inventory_item_id = ii.id WHERE wl.at >= DATE_TRUNC('week', NOW())

WITH weekly_variance AS ( SELECT mi.name AS item, SUM(ABS(sm.delta)) AS actual_usage, GREATEST(SUM(ri.quantity_per_unit * o_count.cnt), 1) AS expected_usage FROM stock_movements sm JOIN inventory_lots il ON sm.inventory_lot_id = il.id JOIN inventory_items ii ON il.inventory_item_id = ii.id JOIN recipe_ingredients ri ON ri.inventory_item_id = ii.id JOIN menu_items mi ON ri.menu_item_id = mi.id CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE placed_at >= DATE_TRUNC('week', NOW()) AND state NOT IN ('cancelled') ) o_count WHERE sm.at >= DATE_TRUNC('week', NOW()) AND sm.delta < 0 GROUP BY mi.name ) SELECT item, ROUND(((actual_usage - expected_usage)::numeric / expected_usage * 100)::numeric, 1) AS "Variance %" FROM weekly_variance ORDER BY ABS(actual_usage - expected_usage) / expected_usage DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Variance detail — all items this week

targets.rawSql: WITH weekly_variance AS ( SELECT mi.name AS item, SUM(ABS(sm.delta)) AS actual_usage, GREATEST(SUM(ri.quantity_per_unit * o_count.cnt), 1) AS expected_usage FROM stock_movements sm JOIN inventory_lots il ON sm.inventory_lot_id = il.id JOIN inventory_items ii ON il.inventory_item_id = ii.id JOIN recipe_ingredients ri ON ri.inventory_item_id = ii.id JOIN menu_items mi ON ri.menu_item_id = mi.id CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE placed_at >= DATE_TRUNC('week', NOW()) AND state NOT IN ('cancelled') ) o_count WHERE sm.at >= DATE_TRUNC('week', NOW()) AND sm.delta < 0 GROUP BY mi.name ) SELECT item AS "Item", actual_usage AS "Actual (units)", expected_usage AS "Expected (units)", ROUND(((actual_usage - expected_usage)::numeric / expected_usage * 100)::numeric, 1) AS "Variance %", CASE WHEN ABS(actual_usage - expected_usage) / expected_usage < 0.10 THEN '✅ Within T01' WHEN ABS(actual_usage - expected_usage) / expected_usage < 0.20 THEN '⚠️ T01 breach' ELSE '❌ High variance' END AS "Status" FROM weekly_variance ORDER BY ABS(actual_usage - expected_usage) / expected_usage DESC
